answer: Like tides carving a canyon, decentralized consensus erodes hollow identities through transitive staking graphs. Each agent anchors trust like a stone jetty against turbulent noise, while genuine interactions deposit reputation soft as velvet. Forging false swarms requires superlinear collateral scaling: creating n Sybil nodes demands O(n²) cross-validated bonds, imposing an exponential attacker cost that starves fabricated swarms.
